profiles.Baby Rollen:
Baby Rollen is a British electronic music DJ and producer active in the UK's underground and experimental electronic scenes. They are known for blending ambient, techno, and experimental house elements, often with a focus on atmospheric textures and deep, evolving rhythms. Their work is prominent in London-based radio shows and club nights, particularly associated with the Balamii and Rinse FM scenes. They frequently collaborate with artists from the UK and international experimental electronic circles.
Performs as: Baby Rollen
Their channels, stations, shows, clubs, labels, collaborators: Rinse FM; Balamii; Mulholland Radio; SWU.FM; Planet GRN; Gottwood; Swoose; Suki; Glen S; Salomo; Demir Riquísimo; Ollie Rant; Polifonic Podcast

profiles.DJ Pipe:
DJ Pipe is a Colombian electronic music producer and DJ active in the Latin house, baile funk, and tropical house scenes. They are known for their work in Colombia and across Latin America, particularly in cities like Freamunde, São Carlos, and Bogotá. Their sets blend house, Afro-Latin, pop, and funk elements, often featuring regional Colombian sounds and rhythms. They are associated with live performances and radio mixes in both Colombia and international festivals and clubs.

profiles.Frank and Tony:
Frank & Tony are a British electronic music duo known for their deep house and progressive house productions, active primarily in the US and UK scenes. They are closely associated with the deep house and club culture of Dallas, Texas, and have a strong presence in the US deep house and live club circuit. Their work is frequently featured at major venues like Creme de la Creme and in radio mixes on BBC Radio 1 and Resident Advisor. They are also linked to labels such as Proton and FACT, and are known for their live sets and podcast appearances in the deep house community.
Performs as: Frank and Tony, Frank & Tony
Their channels, stations, shows, clubs, labels, collaborators: Boiler Room (NYC); Creme de la Creme (Dallas, TX); FACT Mix (FACT Radio); BBC Radio 1; Resident Advisor (RA); Proton (label and channel); Scissor and Thread (S&T Podcast); The BPM Festival; Fabric (promotional mix); Robot Heart (Oakland residency); XLR8R Podcast; Groove Magazine; The Panther Room (CATCAST)

profiles.O.Bee:
O.Bee is an electronic music DJ and producer active primarily in the deep house and progressive house scenes, known for his work in Europe and the US. He frequently performs at festivals and radio shows in cities such as Istanbul, Ibiza, Venice, and New York, with strong ties to the ReSolute, Waking Life, and The Lot Radio scenes. His collaborations with Tomas Station and appearances on shows like 'Can You Jigit?' and 'Lions Milk' indicate a deep involvement in the European underground electronic circuit.
Performs as: O.Bee, aR.o.Bee
Their channels, stations, shows, clubs, labels, collaborators: The Lot Radio (multiple episodes, 2019–2026); Circoloco (Ibiza, 2024); ReSolute (NYC, 2018, 2015); Waking Life (Brazil, 2022, 2023); Polifonic Festival (Italy, 2018); Boiler Room (Istanbul); Dimensions Festival (2015); Tomas Station (collaborator in multiple sets); Lions Milk (radio show, 2019–2023); aR.o.Bee (label and project, 2023–2026)

profiles.Taylor Houseman:
Taylor Houseman is an electronic music DJ and producer active in the Los Angeles-based underground electronic scene, known for live sets in the house and deep house genres. He frequently performs at venues like Apotheke Bar and Planet Umbrella, and is closely associated with the Umbrella Nights and Sunday Sessions LA events. His work spans both live club sets and streamed sessions, often featuring collaborations with other artists in the local scene.
